notes: OpenCode free-model availability changes; refresh-routing only chooses IDs that opencode models currently reports.
Automatic subscription routing requires OpenAI OAuth and/or GitHub Copilot OAuth to appear in opencode auth list; API-key or environment-only credentials are ignored.
GitHub Copilot gpt-5.6-* is temporarily excluded from automatic routing because current OpenCode/Copilot builds have reported integration failures for that family.
Review prefers a model different from Deep when one is available.
OpenCode Scout is experimental in the stable line and is not required; Build uses native web tools for external research.
Full-session model changes are always explicit user actions through /models; automatic routing delegates only bounded chunks to Deep.
Model advice should be task-specific and evidence-informed; do not turn benchmark results into a universal ranking.
